g.text: C4-L1 Container Diagram — SkillSwap (C4 standard Level 2)

Current implementation: web and mobile booking screens call the real hold and confirm endpoints and PaymentGateway is backed by the SePay Payment Gateway adapter (hosted checkout + IPN, ADR-033); payout is not implemented.
Backend signs classroom invitations and document upload links locally. No network call to Jitsi/MinIO is implied.
HTTP labels describe local development; production ingress is HTTPS. The web app connects to the API for every feature screen, not only status calls.
